payload.message:
Execute naist-onboarding skill in MAIL_DIGEST mode. Read ~/.openclaw/skills/naist-onboarding/SKILL.md and follow it.

For each subdirectory under ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ (each represents a slug):
1. Read state files: {{profile.lateness.stakeholders.channel}}_naist.txt, slack_channel.txt. If either missing, skip that slug and post one line to #metrics ({{profile.channels.reportChannel}}): 'naist-mail-digest: <slug> not yet onboarded — run onboarding wizard'.
2. Use Gmail MCP search_threads with query 'from:*naist* OR from:*@*.naist* newer_than:12h is:unread' (forwarded {{profile.education.institution}} mails arrive in Gmail; the original From header is preserved).
3. For each thread: get subject, sender, snippet via Gmail MCP get_thread.
4. Build a Japanese digest grouped by sender domain. Truncate body snippets at 200 chars. List up to 20 threads.
5. Post the digest to the channel ID in slack_channel.txt via Slack API. Format: '📬 *{{profile.education.institution}}メール（直近12時間・未読）*' followed by per-thread lines '・<sender> — <subject> (<snippet>)'. End with '返信したいスレッドがあれば「<番号>に返信」と言ってください。'
6. Print a one-line status to stdout ('Posted mail digest for <slug>: N threads' or 'no new mail for <slug>') so cron announce can relay it to #metrics.

If ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ directory does not exist or is empty: print 'naist-mail-digest: no users onboarded yet — skipping' and exit 0.

Do NOT call the message tool. Do NOT modify openclaw.json.

Execute naist-papers skill in DAILY mode. Read ~/.openclaw/skills/naist-papers/SKILL.md and follow it.

For each subdirectory under ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ (each represents a slug):
1. Read state files: research_topic.json, slack_channel.txt. If either missing, post one line to #metrics ({{profile.channels.reportChannel}}): 'naist-papers-daily: <slug> not yet onboarded' and skip.
2. Use bash scripts/search_arxiv.sh with the topic phrase, count=10, field=all. Filter to papers from the last 24h via the published date.
3. Cross-filter by categories array from research_topic.json (e.g. cs.AI, cs.HC). If the topic is broad or no recent papers match, fall back to 3 most-recent papers in the categories.
4. Pick the 3 most-relevant papers. Generate Japanese summaries per the SKILL.md format (3-4 lines each).
5. Post to the channel ID in slack_channel.txt: '📄 *今日のarXiv論文（<topic>）*' followed by 3 entries.
6. Print a one-line status to stdout ('Posted N papers for <slug>' or 'no new papers for <slug>') so cron announce relays it to #metrics.

If ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ directory missing or empty: print 'naist-papers-daily: no users onboarded yet — skipping' and exit 0.

Do NOT call the message tool. Do NOT modify openclaw.json.

Execute naist-funds skill in WEEKLY mode. Read ~/.openclaw/skills/naist-funds/SKILL.md and follow it.

For each subdirectory under ~/.openclaw/state/naist/:
1. Read slack_channel.txt. If missing, post one line to #metrics ({{profile.channels.reportChannel}}): 'naist-funds-weekly: <slug> not yet onboarded' and skip.
2. Run: cd /Users/anicca/.openclaw/skills/naist-funds && SLACK_CHANNEL_ID=$(cat ~/.openclaw/state/naist/<slug>/slack_channel.txt) node scripts/scan.js — this scans JSPS / 学振 / 科研費 / JST / JFUND for new opportunities since the last run (cache.json gating).
3. The script posts to the SLACK_CHANNEL_ID itself.
4. Print a one-line status to stdout ('Posted N funds for <slug>' or 'no new funds for <slug>') so cron announce relays it to #metrics.

If ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ directory missing or empty: print 'naist-funds-weekly: no users onboarded yet — skipping' and exit 0.

Do NOT call the message tool. Do NOT modify openclaw.json.

Execute naist-deadline skill in REMINDER mode. Read ~/.openclaw/skills/naist-deadline/SKILL.md and follow it.

For each subdirectory under ~/.openclaw/state/naist/:
1. Read slack_channel.txt. If missing, post one line to #metrics ({{profile.channels.reportChannel}}): 'naist-deadline-reminder: <slug> not yet onboarded' and skip.
2. Read ~/.openclaw/skills/naist-deadline/data/deadlines.json. Filter to entries with status != 'done' AND due_date in {today, tomorrow} (Asia/Tokyo).
3. If 0 hits for this slug, do nothing (no Slack post). Otherwise post to slack_channel.txt the formatted reminder per SKILL.md '一覧' format, prefixed with '⏰ *締切リマインド（明日まで）*'.
4. Print a one-line status to stdout ('Posted N deadlines for <slug>' or 'no upcoming deadlines for <slug>') so cron announce relays it to #metrics.

If ~/.openclaw/state/naist/ directory missing or empty: print 'naist-deadline-reminder: no users onboarded yet — skipping' and exit 0.
